next_question: This packet's most valuable result is not its MEASUREMENT_INVALID label, which is a correct and cheap substrate diagnosis, but a bounded defect in the frozen certificate itself that the producer and the auditor both saw only partially: the gate as frozen can certify that SUBSTRATE IS PRESENT but it can never certify that the TREATMENT ARM CAN DIFFER FROM ITS COMPARATOR, so this design would burn its entire remaining budget and still return zero information even after every named prerequisite is satisfied. I verified that at source rather than inferring it. spec.json A-SPIDER names the mechanism registry 'as currently implemented in src/spider/kernel.py', and prereg.md section 4 requires induction by distill_parameterized(); no such function exists in the 132-line kernel at HEAD, which offers only a literal distill(). Worse, the literal path is closed by construction: distill() hardcodes confidence=0.5 (src/spider/kernel.py line 90), resolve() defaults min_confidence=0.8 (line 59) and returns Resolution(ResolutionStatus.EXPLORE, ..., bound_action=None) whenever the best candidate falls below that threshold (line 114), so no mechanism produced by the shipped kernel's own distill() can EVER resolve to EXECUTABLE and no bound_action is ever produced. Since spec.json also gives A-SPIDER the SAME TF-IDF Jaccard K=5 retrieval as B-RETRIEVAL for budget matching, a fully passing readiness certificate would leave A-SPIDER indistinguishable from its own strong baseline by construction, and the frozen falsifier would then report a vacuous SUPPORTS or FALSIFIES about a comparison with no treatment contrast in it. That is a design defect of the same class as the parent packet's frozen-rule defect, and it is cheaper to fix than the credential: it is one more pre-execution control, not one more arm. THE NEXT QUESTION, which must not be executed on the current substrate and must not be a fifth re-run of the same gate: does a real external LLM agent at identical model, tools and budget benefit from SPIDER's inherited mechanisms beyond a retrieval baseline, once the experiment is made arm-differentiation-valid BEFORE any expensive arm runs -- concretely, (1) a FOURTH mandatory pre-execution certificate check, the treatment-arm liveness control, which must be SHOWN TO FIRE on a synthetic fixture before the gate passes: a known-positive round trip in which an induction observation distils to a mechanism that resolves to EXECUTABLE with a non-null bound_action and executes, AND a known-negative round trip in which a wrong-parameter or out-of-support binding is refused with a recorded reason, because a certificate that can only detect absence cannot detect a degenerate treatment; (2) the shipped kernel must be able to execute an inherited mechanism at all, so distill_parameterized() must exist and the distill-to-resolve confidence path must be closed or deliberately widened, with the resulting EXECUTABLE rate on the induction set itself reported as a gate quantity rather than discovered during the arms; (3) the PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY control must additionally demonstrate-firing on the inherited path, so the cost model's retrieval_calls, verification_calls and repair_attempts terms are shown to increment on a mechanism execution and not only on a scripted trajectory; (4) freeze.json must bind a task-bank hash and a src/spider/kernel.py hash, or a documented preregistered substitute, so substrate is immutable at freeze instead of discovered post hoc, which is this program's fourth-plus recorded sighting of the freeze-cannot-bind-code defect and the direct cause of this packet's check-2 failure being unreconcilable; and (5) the falsifier must be rewritten so that A-SPIDER and B-RETRIEVAL cannot tie by construction, for example by requiring a non-zero rate of tasks in which the bound mechanism was actually the executed action, so a retrieval-shaped A-SPIDER arm is detected as the null it is rather than scored as a result. If no model credential can be provisioned, the correct disposition is to fail at DESIGN with the exact provisioning receipt named, not to re-freeze and re-execute this gate a sixth time: a deterministic pre-DESIGN probe of the four named prerequisites (credential present and returning 200 within 30s, playwright and httpx importable, a committed task bank with at least 30 mechanical verifiers, and a kernel that resolves to EXECUTABLE) costs minutes and has now replaced a full cycle five times over.
